```{r}
library(readxl)
health_dataset_updated <- read_excel("health_dataset_updated.xlsx")
View(health_dataset_updated)
```

```{r}
health_dataset <- health_dataset_updated %>%
  mutate(Name = str_to_title(Name),
         Gender = str_to_title(Gender),
         Medical_Condition = str_to_title(Medical_Condition),
         Admission_Type = str_to_title(Admission_Type))
```


```{r}
# Make sure to load stringr for text cleaning
library(stringr)

# Fix inconsistent capitalization in Name and Gender
health_dataset_updated$Name <- str_to_title(health_dataset_updated$Name)   # e.g., "Bobby Jackson"
health_dataset_updated$Gender <- str_to_title(health_dataset_updated$Gender) # e.g., "Male", "Female"
View(health_dataset_updated)
```


```{r}
colnames(health_dataset_updated)
```
```{r}
# Missing values
colSums(is.na(health_dataset))

# Check for inconsistent capitalizations
health_dataset <- health_dataset %>%
  mutate(Name = str_to_title(Name),
         Gender = str_to_title(Gender),
         Medical_Condition = str_to_title(Medical_Condition),
         Admission_Type = str_to_title(Admission_Type))

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# 1️⃣ Clean Name and Gender
health_dataset_updated <- health_dataset_updated %>%
  mutate(
    Name = str_to_title(Name),
    Gender = str_to_title(Gender)
  )

# 2️⃣ Recalculate length_of_stay
health_dataset_updated <- health_dataset_updated %>%
  mutate(length_of_stay_calc = as.numeric(Discharge_Date - Admission_Date),
         length_mismatch = length_of_stay != length_of_stay_calc,
         length_of_stay = length_of_stay_calc)  # Replace with computed value

# 3️⃣ Quick check
summary(health_dataset_updated)
View(health_dataset_updated)
```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(health_dataset_updated, aes(x = length_of_stay, y = length_of_stay_calc)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Original vs Computed Length of Stay",
    x = "Original length_of_stay",
    y = "Computed length_of_stay_calc"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```







```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

# Monthly admissions over time
health_dataset_updated %>%
  group_by(Year = year(Admission_Date), Month = month(Admission_Date)) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, 1, sep = "-")), y = Count)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Admissions Over Time", x = "Month", y = "Number of Admissions") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
health_dataset_updated %>%
  group_by(Year = year(Admission_Date), Month = month(Admission_Date)) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  mutate(Month_Year = as.Date(paste(Year, Month, 1, sep = "-"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Month_Year, y = Count)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Admissions Over Time", x = "Month", y = "Number of Admissions") +
```



```{r}
health_dataset_updated %>%
  mutate(Month = month(Admission_Date, label = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(Year = year(Admission_Date), Month) %>%
  summarise(Count = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Month, y = factor(Year), fill = Count)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +
  labs(title = "Monthly Admissions Heatmap", x = "Month", y = "Year", fill = "Admissions") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Top 10 Doctors by number of patients
health_dataset_updated %>%
  count(Doctor, sort = TRUE) %>%
  top_n(10) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Doctor, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Doctors by Number of Patients", x = "Doctor", y = "Number of Patients") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(health_dataset_updated, aes(x = `Admission Type`, y = `Billing Amount`, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(title = "Billing Amount by Admission Type and Gender", x = "Admission Type", y = "Billing Amount") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(health_dataset_updated, aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution", x = "Age", y = "Count")
```

```{r}
# Summary by medical condition
library(dplyr)
health_dataset_updated %>%
  group_by(Age_Group, Critical) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Billing = mean(Billing_Amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    Avg_LOS = mean(length_of_stay_calc, na.rm = TRUE),
    Count = n()
  )

```
